experiment: Claim B / C5 -- dialogue-SFT vs monologue-SFT priming, then identical PPO
design: Three arms share ONE prompt template ending at 'Assistant:' (no pre-opened <think>) and ONE PPO config recovered verbatim from Tier-0. The only difference across arms is the starting weights: base / dialogue-primed / monologue-primed. PPO set is TinyZero's own countdown parquet with only the prompt string swapped (rl.claimB_data.rewrite_ppo_prompt).
metric: val/test_score/countdown (verl stock Countdown scorer, 1312 held-out problems)
caveat: n=1 per arm per model. No error bars. Differences under ~0.03 are not distinguishable from run-to-run noise at this n.

Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B.note: the base model the SoT paper uses for Claim B

meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B.note: second base model, run to test whether the Qwen convergence is model-specific

logs: raw verl logs archived on the Spark at ~/claimB_logs/ (Qwen) and ~/claimB_logs/llama_final/ (Llama)
